description:
Create a 4-slide presentation based on the text outline provided in '/home/ga/Documents/TaskData/ethics_lecture_outline.txt'.

1. Open the text file and copy the content.
2. In LibreOffice Impress, switch to 'Outline View' (View > Outline).
3. Paste the text into the outline. Ensure the structure creates 4 distinct slides (titles should be top-level, details should be indented bullet points).
4. Save the presentation as '/home/ga/Documents/Presentations/ethics_lecture.odp'.
